text:
cheng: Heads up — canary perf alert after today's scheduler refactor merge (commit abc123). tokens/sec down ~18% on canary, latency p95 up ~25%. https://perf.redwood.internal/d/xyz
ops-bot: CI/perf-check: FAILED — tokens_per_sec drop -17% (threshold -10%). See /ci/perf/2419.
maria: saw the same on canary. queue-aging metric spikes, many batches under 8 tokens.
sam: bisecting now, initial suspicion: the new slot allocator + prefetch threshold change. running workload bisect.
linda: hold the rollout. pausing auto-rollout and blocking further canary promotion. :warning:
cheng: logging from the runtime on one canary host: `WARN scheduler: enqueue wait 172ms, batch_size=3, seq_len_median=12`
maria: kv-cache hitrate dipped ~6% at the same time — looks like a side effect of the prefetch reorder? pulling logs.
sam: bisect points to commit def456 (prefetch/slot allocator tweak). reverting that commit locally drops the token/sec regression in my harness.
cheng: can someone open a revert PR and tag infra? I'll attach profiler traces.
linda: opened rollback PR #4821, marked as emergency revert, pinged oncall.
ops-bot: deploy rollback triggered by linda — canary rollback started. status: in_progress.
maria: attaching flame snippet from `go tool pprof` (abbreviated): `sched.AcquireSlot -> prefetcher.Check -> batcher.Drain` hot path increased 3x.
sam: temp fix idea: relax prefetch threshold and re-enable batch_coalesce window. small patch 4822 disables prefetch reorder; will run canary.
cheng: running perf harness `./perf/harness --workload=chatty --tokens=1M --profile=pprof.out` now.
linda: rollback completed on canary, ops-bot shows tokens/sec back to baseline +1%. holding rollout until patch lands and we get CI perf green. :white_check_mark:
maria: will add metrics: `batch_size_percentile`, `queue_age_hist`, and `kv_invalidation_count` in follow-up.
sam: will open a focused test in CI that runs long-ish chatty workload to catch this next time.
cheng: thanks all — follow-ups: revert PR merged then re-land with smaller prefetch delta + perf test. I'll file a postmortem note.
